text.title: Agency Revenue Mix Audit Template Decision Tree
text.summary: Routes on whether twelve months of delivery-dated revenue exist and on what distorts the top line — pass-through rebilling or owner-delivered work — to full application, a corrected-base first step, or skip.

decision-tree.root-question: Is there a full trailing twelve months of revenue that can be attributed to service delivery dates rather than to cash receipts?

branch.when: the books are cash-basis only; deposits, prepayments and issued invoices cannot be spread across the delivery period they cover

conclusion.verdict: halt; re-cut the window on delivery dates before any percentage is computed — a cash-cut mix reports collection timing as predictability

branch.when: the agency has traded under twelve months, or fewer than three clients were billed in the window

conclusion.verdict: skip; concentration thresholds on a two-client book restate what the founder already knows, and a partial window has no comparable prior period

branch.when: twelve months of delivery-dated revenue is available and attributable per client
branch.question: What sits inside the top line: material pass-through cost rebilled at or near cost, revenue the owner personally delivers, or neither?

branch.when: media spend, ad buys, print, licences or subcontractor cost are rebilled through the P&L

conclusion.verdict: apply, but split pass-through onto its own line first and compute every share on net revenue — a billings-based mix inverts once a buyer restates it

branch.when: no material pass-through, but the owner still bills delivery hours on live accounts

conclusion.verdict: apply, starting with an `owner_billed` line carrying the underlying delivery hours; it never folds into `project` or `retainer`, even where the owner draws no salary for it

branch.when: no material pass-through and the owner delivers no billable hours

conclusion.verdict: apply the full methodology; the client thresholds (20% single, 50% top-three), the 25% referral-origination threshold, and the term-plus-notice test for anything called a retainer are the gates
